usedFor: Yousign holds your signing users, and Todoist holds the follow-up, so “New User” becomes “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Yousign, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: A new user in Yousign creates a Todoist task with a title and details, so someone sets them up.

watchOut: “New User” in Yousign is polling, so the task appears after a scheduled check.
